name: static_scan

test_list.description: A known blocking call in an async Rust function yields a source-located advisory finding with non-source metadata evidence.
The same call in a synchronous function is not mislabeled as async blocking.
Words in comments or literals cannot create a parser-derived finding.
Configured automata matches retain rule identity and byte spans.
Missing parser coverage never becomes a clean bill of health.
Secrets embedded in unsafe syntax are never copied into finding evidence, even when DFA rules do not identify them.
File count, per-file/aggregate bytes, paths and finding accumulation are hard bounded and return an error without a partial report.

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: Caller-owned bounded source byte slices with relative paths and explicit languages.

output_description: Deterministic, zero-model-token AST and DFA observations. Source bytes are not copied into evidence; findings carry metadata and source locations. Inputs and finding accumulation are hard bounded. Heuristics remain advisory.
